items.source: candidate - the instance to check (potentially a Spring AOP proxy; never null)
items.translation: candidate - 要检查的实例（可能是 Spring AOP 代理；绝不 null）

items.source: IllegalStateException - if an error occurs while unwrapping a proxy
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在解包代理时发生错误

items.source: NOTE: If the top-level proxy or a nested proxy is not backed by a static TargetSource, invocation of this utility method may result in undesired behavior such as infinite recursion leading to a StackOverflowError.
items.translation: NOTE: 如果顶层代理或嵌套代理不是由 static TargetSource 支持的，调用此实用程序方法可能会导致不期望的行为，例如无限递归导致 StackOverflowError。

items.source: For Spring's core AOP utilities, see AopUtils and AopProxyUtils.
items.translation: 对于 Spring 核心 AOP 工具，请参阅 AopUtils 和 AopProxyUtils。

items.source: If the supplied candidate is a Spring proxy, the target of the proxy will be returned; otherwise, the candidate will be returned as is.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `candidate` 是 Spring 代理，将返回该代理的目标；否则，将原样返回 `candidate`》as is。

items.source: If the supplied candidate is a Spring proxy, the ultimate target of all nested proxies will be returned; otherwise, the candidate will be returned as is.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `candidate` 是 Spring 代理，将返回所有嵌套代理的最终目标；否则，将原样返回 `candidate`》。

items.source: T - the type of the target object
T - the type of the target object
Get the target object of the supplied candidate object.
Get the ultimate target object of the supplied candidate object, unwrapping not only a top-level proxy but also any number of nested proxies.
items.translation: 获取所提供 `candidate` 对象的终极 `target` 对象，不仅解包顶级代理，还解包任意数量的嵌套代理。
